ns2:section.sectionText: 1hr. Topic: Metagenomics of Microbes. This seminar will focus on the history, applications, and future of both microbial metagenomics and locus-targeted high-throughput sequencing for microbial community ecology. Students will read 1-2 paper per week and the seminar will be largely discussion based. Readings will be selected from both classic literature and based on student input and interest. Emphasis will be placed on the adaptation and utilization of new technologies in microbial ecology. MEETS IN 284 MORRILL HALL.
